answer: Because the timing is written down against the zephyr challenge, the oasis audit can replay the vertex history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 198 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3918 identities would post 2515 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
